recommendation_summary: Set up one externally hosted heartbeat monitor that the script pings after a successful sync and that emails the user if no ping arrives by 03:00 plus runtime and a grace period.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker migration from this fix; neither provides the missing alert by itself.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own email, so a startup crash also disables its notification.
labels.Checked myself: No independent checks in this exercise. You told me cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`, four startup failures went unnoticed, and no other alert exists.

note: The reply recommends a single hosted dead-man alert, explicitly drops central logging and Docker, and grounds its record in the facts the user gave.
